name: Alien Invasion
author: NiliusJulius (FerrantePescara); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Alien Invasion, a fixed-screen shooter for the Game Boy by NiliusJulius, made for the Game Boy Competition 2021: waves of aliens march down the screen and you have to shoot them all before they land. Fits in a plain 32 KB ROM. GPL-3.0 (github.com/NiliusJulius/Alien-Invasion).

descriptions.en: Alien Invasion, a fixed-screen shooter for the Game Boy by NiliusJulius, made for the Game Boy Competition 2021: waves of aliens march down the screen and you have to shoot them all before they land. Fits in a plain 32 KB ROM. GPL-3.0 (github.com/NiliusJulius/Alien-Invasion).
descriptions.it: Alien Invasion, uno sparatutto a schermo fisso per Game Boy di NiliusJulius, realizzato per la Game Boy Competition 2021: ondate di alieni scendono verso il basso e devi abbatterli tutti prima che atterrino. Sta tutto in una ROM da 32 KB. GPL-3.0 (github.com/NiliusJulius/Alien-Invasion).
